about_the_game:
Step into an alternate-reality USSR where the past collides with alien technology: monolithic concrete structures tower over glowing extraterrestrial machinery, all brought to life with nostalgic pixel-art flair. Battle across wildly unique maps — from secret lunar bases to underground bunkers codenamed “Volga-12”.

Choose from a roster of eccentric fighters: Baba Yaga, the engineer-inventor piloting a robotic hut-mech, or Kot Uchyony (The Scientist Cat) — yes, he’s literally a cat and a genius! Each hero boasts a game-changing ultimate ability, like summoning a swarm of cybernetic crows or deploying a reality-warping “Communism Wave” that turns foes into collectivist zealots.

Every location hides optional side objectives: hack an alien reactor to trigger a “Red Overdrive” buff for your team, or seize control of the giant automaton “Kuzmich” to crush enemies with its rocket-powered hammer. Win these mini-wars to gain powerful boosts — but expect ruthless resistance!

Mix Cold War-era aesthetics with alien futurism in our deep customization system. Equip your hero with a ushanka hat wired with holographic tech, or strap a vintage gas mask to a cyborg’s glowing visor. Style matters as much as stats.

Climb the ranks in competitive matches, forge a clan like “CosmoZavod-7”, and battle through leagues with real stakes. Our anti-cheat system and balanced gameplay ensure victory depends on skill — not exploits.

Team up in co-op missions against alien hordes and rogue AI. Uncover the world’s secrets: from humanity’s first contact with extraterrestrials to the rise of the MKPZ — a USSR-led global defense force.

name: METACRAFT: Arena

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3470 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 / Intel Arc A310
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570 / Intel Arc A380
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: METACRAFT: Arena — Dive into a chaotic fusion of Soviet retrofuturism, frenetic combat, and tactical mastery, where every match brings you one step closer to glory!
supported_languages: English, Russian, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Turkish, Ukrainian, Finnish, Belarusian, Kazakh, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
